_provenance: Solar system rung — delegates to bigbang's measure function. Uses trainer's constraint format (min/max/value as appropriate).
scenario: Grow a solar system from a seeded protoplanetary disk. The star must dominate. Kepler's law must emerge.

constraints.wall: At least 3 bound planets must form in every restart
Star must contain at least 90% of system mass
Kepler's law must fit with R^2 >= 0.90 in worst restart
Angular momentum drift must be under 5%
At most 15% of mass may escape
